description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller named NoteController, exposing API endpoints for managing notes. It provides CRUD operations and a list endpoint with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing endpoints to create, read, update, delete, and list notes. It maps HTTP requests to service calls and constructs responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST /api/notes to create a new note and returns the created note with location header.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET /api/notes/{id} to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT /api/notes/{id} to update an existing note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE /api/notes/{id} to delete a note.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET /api/notes with optional filters and pagination to list notes.
